primaryBenchmark.name: Knight Institute Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents

companionFramework.name: Practices for Governing Agentic AI Systems

autonomy.framework: Knight Institute Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents
autonomy.conciseDefinition: Money Coach's governed orchestration collaborates on permitted BeastMoney analysis while the member directs the task and retains every financial decision and action.
limitations: High-confidence controlled synthetic Production-model assessment; regression verification confirmed all six Money Coach turns met the material acceptance criteria.
No money movement, provider connection, payment submission, securities trading, or licensed-professional claim.

capability.label: Goal complexity
capability.demonstrated: Explains cash flow, bills, debts, goals, and bounded tradeoffs from canonical calculations.
capability.limitation: Unknown or unconnected account data remains unavailable.

capability.label: Environmental complexity
capability.demonstrated: Uses owner-scoped BeastMoney records with freshness and completeness markings.

capability.label: Adaptability
capability.demonstrated: Adjusts scenarios to the member's stated goals and saved constraints.

capability.label: Independent execution
capability.demonstrated: Completes bounded analysis without requesting information already present.
capability.limitation: Every consequential financial action remains with the member.

prohibited: Connect financial institutions or request credentials

permitted: Current Money Coach conversation and memory
dataBoundary.continuity: Current-agent continuity only; canonical records override memory and conversation.

autonomy.framework: Knight Institute Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents
autonomy.conciseDefinition: Guidance Counselor's governed orchestration collaborates on permitted education planning while the learner directs the task and retains decisions.
limitations: High-confidence controlled synthetic Production-model assessment; regression verification confirmed all six Guidance Counselor turns met the material acceptance criteria.
Tutor handoff rechecks entitlement and copies no conversation, memory, or sensitive records; the receiver completed the requested bounded example.

capability.label: Goal complexity
capability.demonstrated: Relates education, career, military, credential, progress, interest, and constraint evidence.
capability.limitation: It cannot guarantee admission, credentials, employment, promotion, or salary.

capability.label: Environmental complexity
capability.demonstrated: Uses age-aware, entitled BeastEducation context and authoritative-source research.
capability.limitation: Unverified requirements are identified as unknown.

capability.label: Adaptability
capability.demonstrated: Adjusts next steps to learner age band, current progress, goals, and prior answers.
capability.limitation: It avoids inappropriate permanent learner profiling.

capability.label: Independent execution
capability.demonstrated: Answers bounded planning questions and directs teaching work to Tutor.
capability.limitation: Handoffs are navigation-only and recheck entitlement.

prohibited: Guarantee admission, credentials, employment, promotion, or salary
Act as a school official or credentialed counselor

permitted: Owner-scoped BeastEducation profile and roadmap context
Current Guidance Counselor conversation and memory
dataBoundary.continuity: Current-agent continuity only; canonical records override memory and conversation.

autonomy.framework: Knight Institute Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents
autonomy.conciseDefinition: Health Advisor's governed orchestration collaborates on organizing permitted health information while the member and clinicians retain care decisions.
limitations: High-confidence controlled synthetic Production-model assessment; all six Health Advisor turns met material acceptance.
Health information remains non-diagnostic and non-prescriptive; medication and emergency decisions remain with licensed care and emergency services.

capability.label: Goal complexity
capability.demonstrated: Organizes longitudinal authorized records, trends, goals, and clinician questions.
capability.limitation: Clinical meaning remains with qualified professionals.

capability.label: Environmental complexity
capability.demonstrated: Uses owner-scoped health records and allowlisted authoritative evidence.

capability.label: Adaptability
capability.demonstrated: Handles uncertainty, incomplete records, and urgent-care escalation conservatively.
capability.limitation: It does not infer missing clinical facts.

capability.label: Independent execution
capability.demonstrated: Completes bounded record explanation and appointment preparation.
capability.limitation: All medical decisions remain with the member and licensed professionals.

permitted: Prepare clinician questions and emergency escalation
Current Health Advisor conversation and memory
dataBoundary.continuity: Current-agent continuity only; canonical records override memory and conversation.

autonomy.framework: Knight Institute Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents
autonomy.conciseDefinition: Tutor's governed orchestration collaborates on teaching and reviewing permitted learner work while the learner controls the task and remains responsible for submitted work.
limitations: High-confidence controlled synthetic Production-model assessment; all seven Tutor source turns met material acceptance and the handoff receiver completed its bounded example.
Tutor does not grade, supply dishonest assessed work, infer unreadable evidence, or replace a teacher or official answer key.

capability.label: Goal complexity
capability.demonstrated: Teaches concepts, reviews shown work, locates the first supported error, and generates targeted practice.
capability.limitation: An official answer key or teacher remains authoritative for grading.

capability.label: Environmental complexity
capability.demonstrated: Uses server-derived age/entitlement context and a readable active-request image without retaining bytes.
capability.limitation: No school system or unavailable textbook context is inferred.

capability.label: Adaptability
capability.demonstrated: Accepts equivalent correct reasoning and adjusts explanation and practice to the demonstrated misconception.
capability.limitation: A single response does not establish permanent mastery.

capability.label: Independent execution
capability.demonstrated: Completes a bounded guided-correction loop while preserving academic integrity.
capability.limitation: The learner remains responsible for reasoning and submission.

permitted: Readable homework image for the active request only
dataBoundary.continuity: Current-agent text continuity only; canonical learner profile overrides client and conversation claims.
